facts.title: gravity release during a planned shutdown on HO-9403

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LIFTING_GEAR_INSPECTION: the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work on HO-9403 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically preparing and approving a lift study. HO-9403 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 15 July 2015 an incident occurred on HO-9403 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a planned shutdown, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
